thread:
maria: Hey team — requesting a quick slot to onboard Vectora-33B (open, 33B, 8-bit-first-pass). Early bench: +6% ROUGE-L on long-summary suite but token cost ~3x vs atlas40b. Latency p50 220ms p95 480ms (configured 32k truncation). Perplexity +1.2 vs baseline.
aj: Q: which eval dataset used for the long-summary win? public long-summ & internal customer-set? we need exact seeds.
sam: Sounds promising. Need a quant plan before we allocate infra. Recommend nf4 int8 -> q8_0 sweep. Also want prompt-tuning check.
infra-bot: infra-check: VPC ok; storage 42GB available; GPU type: A10G x1 available for 48h; network egress estimate: 12GB.
devin: If we can get a reproducible eval PR + quant configs, I'm ok putting this into Friday's intake slot. Suggest canary 10% traffic once gated.
lee: FYI last run flagged some brevity/hallucination regressions on the financial summaries cohort — add hallucination evals to the regression set.
maria: created a mini-checklist:
- PR: eval harness + reproducible seeds
- Quant configs: nf4 int8, q8_0, q4_0
- Latency profile run with batch=1, batch=4
- Rollback plan + fallback model mapping
- Owner: @maria
Sample quant snippet:
```
quant := {
  method: "nf4",
  bits: 8,
  per_channel: true
}
```
aj: i'll add a priority scorecard row: quality 8/10, cost 3/10, infra risk 2/10 => overall 6/10. scheduling suggestion: 2 GPU-days this sprint, 4 next if promising.
sam: ok. i'll draft the quant experiment script and share later today. :thumbsup: 
maria: thanks — i'll put the intake card in the board and link PR when ready. tagging @product for roadmap alignment.
devin: can product confirm acceptance criteria for canary? product: what pass/fail looks like.
product: (from product) pass = no regression >1% on core L2 metrics + latency p95 <600ms and cost uplift <2.5x for 95% traffic.
maria: noted, adjusting checklist. will prioritize hallucination checks and cost simulations.
